BETA Close X Barratt Redrow plc has announced the purchase of 2,000,000 ordinary shares as part of its £386 million share repurchase program. These shares were bought on the London Stock Exchange from Barclays Bank plc between August 10th and August 14th, 2026, with prices ranging from 313.1 pence to 332.4 pence per share. Following these transactions, Barratt Redrow holds no shares in treasury, and its total issued ordinary shares stand at 1,399,233,098, representing the total voting rights. Disclaimer* Barratt Redrow PLC 17 August 2026 17 August 2026 Barratt Redrow plc Transaction in Own Shares Barratt Redrow plc, ISIN: GB0000811801 (the "Company", "Barratt Redrow") announces that during the period from 10 August 2026 to 14 August 2026 (the "Disclosure Period") it has purchased for cancellation the following number of ordinary shares of 10 pence each from Barclays Bank plc ("Barclays") as part of its £386 million share repurchase programme announced on 15 July 2026 (the "Programme"). All shares were purchased from Barclays as an "on exchange" transaction subject to the rules of the London Stock Exchange ("LSE"). Date of Purchase within Disclosure Period Aggregate volume (shares) Highest price paid per share (pence) Lowest price paid per share (pence) Volume weighted average price paid per share (pence) Trading venue 10 Aug 2026 465,148 322.4000 314.8000 318.7015 LSE 11 Aug 2026 397,197 320.5000 313.1000 317.2204 LSE 12 Aug 2026 398,000 329.4000 320.6000 324.9515 LSE 13 Aug 2026 398,000 331.3000 322.3000 328.2206 LSE 14 Aug 2026 398,000 332.0000 325.8000 327.9701 LSE To date, Barratt Redrow has purchased 11,287,155 ordinary shares in aggregate for cancellation from Barclays in accordance with the Buyback Programme. Following the above purchases and cancellation of the ordinary shares, the Company holds no ordinary shares in treasury and has 1,399,233,098 ordinary shares in issue. The total number of voting rights in the Company is therefore 1,399,233,098.
